description: Memformat angka sebagai Rupiah gaya Indonesia. Formats a number as Rupiah: "Rp1.234.567,89" (dot thousands, comma decimals), with or without "Rp", fixed decimals, ",-" suffix, or compact like "Rp1,2 jt" / "Rp1,2 juta".

angka.description: A JSON number, or text such as "1250000", "Rp1.250.000,50" or "1,5 jt". Send very large numbers (>= 2^53) as text.

desimal.description: Decimals 0-4, or "auto" (default: 0 for whole numbers, else 2). Rounds half up.

ringkas.description: Compact: rb / jt / M / T (e.g. "Rp1,2 jt").

ringkas_desimal.description: Max decimals in compact mode (trailing zeros dropped).

ringkas_panjang.description: Compact with full words: ribu / juta / miliar / triliun.

spasi.description: Space after Rp ("Rp 1.000"). Indonesian spelling rules (EYD) write it without a space.

name: format_rupiah
title: Format Rupiah
